data.name: Rubicon Carbon
data.description: Rubicon Carbon is a US-based carbon credit management and investment platform backed by TPG Rise Climate Fund, headquartered in Marina del Rey, California. The company curates risk-adjusted carbon credit portfolios (Rubicon Carbon Tonne, Rubicon Rated Tonne) combining avoidance and removal credits for corporate buyers, and signs multi-year offtake agreements with CDR developers such as Terradot (enhanced weathering), Bio-Logical (biochar), and Deep Sky (DAC). It is a financier/aggregator in the CDR ecosystem rather than a physical removal operator.
